_comment: Telegram Media Downloader Pro reads this file. Edit it, run  python sign/sign_config.py site/desktop/config.json  then upload. Every installed copy picks up the change on its next start - no new build needed. Image paths starting with / are resolved against whichever address served this file.
_moved_to: To move every installed copy to a new address, add  "moved_to": "https://new-address"  while this address still answers, then sign and upload. The app follows it once and remembers it.
